project_philosophy: Hardware Elite, Face Swappable. We build an AI employee and digital office.

theme.strategy: Light theme by default for the platform dashboard to maximize legibility for non-technical SMB owners. Dark/Premium theme for Marketing page for immersion. Provide a toggle.
theme.face_swappable: Establish a robust CSS variable system in index.css (e.g., --tenant-primary) mapped to Tailwind colors so the platform admin can inject specific tenant branding seamlessly over the 'hardware elite' grayscale structure.

typography.monospace: IBM Plex Mono (For metrics, ids, tabular data)
rules: No generic sans like Inter or Roboto for headings.
Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

colors.base: Structural grayscale. Off-white backgrounds (slate-50/zinc-50) with crisp white panels. Heavy reliance on 1px borders.
colors.primary_tenant: CSS Variable driven (--primary). Default to Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) or Elite Cobalt for the base platform.
rules: Always tint neutral greys with a slight cool blue/slate tone.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays/dropdowns. Use glassmorphism or solid.
Only use primary/brand color for CTAs like buttons and forms. Limit the use of primary color.

layouts.marketing_page: Bento 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetric. Generous spacing (p-12, p-24). Overlapping elements. Use Lenis smooth scrolling.
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid. The 20-item sidebar MUST be categorized using logical groups (e.g., Workspace, Communications, Tools, Administration) with overline headers to avoid overwhelming the user.
layouts.onboarding_wizard: SaaSFrame pattern. Multi-step split screen (left visual/art, right form) with clear progress indicators, utilizing generous padding.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Crystal variant for sticky elements. High opacity (bg-white/70 or bg-black/60), backdrop-blur-xl, backdrop-saturate-150, 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Dashboard widgets should be flat solid surfaces with 1px border (border-border). No heavy shadows on resting state. Use subtle roundness (max 12px or rounded-xl).

components.strategy: HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Custom Shadcn UI for dashboard and wizard.
components.customizations: Override default Shadcn styles. Ensure generous padding, sharp interactions, and layered shadows on interactive states.
components.forbidden: No HTML native selects or date pickers. Use Shadcn components exclusively for complex interactions.

motion.rules: No universal 'transition: all'. Explicit transitions only (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease). Staggered list entrances. Hover lift (-translate-y-1) for cards.

hero_marketing.description: Relaxed SMB owner. Use for emotional hook on the marketing site.

ai_concept.description: Curved architectural ribs representing elite structural AI/tech framework.

digital_office.description: Premium minimal office desk representing the 'done for you' digital workspace.

accessibility.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tenant-sidebar-item').
accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for small text. Explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Establish the 'hardware elite' structure first-crisp borders, exact padding, flawless grids-then inject the 'swappable face' (tenant primary color).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crystal glass-morphism.
Do not center-align the app container globally. Left-align text for dense content.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons.
Use sonner for toasts. Do not use plain HTML for notifications.
Do not use placeholder text for missing images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Grid Layouts: Ensure grid children are direct descendants.

Since the dashboard has 20 sections, grouping them is paramount for the non-technical user. Grouping ideas: AI Employee, Communications (Calls, Messages), Business (Leads, Customers, Appointments, Services, Payments, Website, Portal, Reviews), Analytics & Intelligence (Analytics, Advisor, Knowledge Base), Settings & Setup (Automations, Integrations, Phone Numbers, Usage, Billing, Settings).
Always apply GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: micro-animations, 2-3x more spacing, and sharp button styles.
